Hi team — quick commercial note so we can be prepared on Wed:

- Hosted trial: we can provision a standard hosted trial with default rate limits (X tokens/sec per account). For the hands-on tests, we usually grant a temporary quota bump to match expected concurrency for 48–72 hours.
- Dedicated trial: if you want to reserve Dedicated capacity for the POC, that requires a short commitment (30 days minimum) and a different provisioning lead time — we can often do a 2-week trial on Dedicated via a temporary reserved pool but need procurement sign-off.

Action requested from Finfy: please indicate whether you want us to request a hosted quota bump for the Wed test, or whether you'd prefer we prepare a Dedicated reserve quote to discuss during the call. If hosted, please confirm the target concurrent sessions (I see Maya suggested ~50).

I'll prepare the capacity request form and a simple cost estimate once you confirm. Attaching the capacity request template; Connor, can you add it to the Drive?

Thanks,
